description: Submission of the Annual Report of the Public Debt Management Office for the year 2025 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: As per section 25 of the Public Debt Management Act, No.33 of 2024, the Public Debt Management Office shall prepare an Annual Report on Government borrowings of the Government and other debt management operations, outstanding public debt, guarantees and on-lending activities and other financing arrangements entered into during the previous financial year. Further, as mentioned in the said Act, the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance shall review the draft of the Annual Report and submit it to the Cabinet for approval, and thereafter the approved Annual Report shall be submitted to Parliament within 180 days of the end of the preceding financial year. The said Report approved by Parliament shall also be published on the official websites of the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development and the Public Debt Management Office. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, for the Annual Report prepared by the Public Debt Management Office for the year ended as at 2025 12 31 and for the submission of the said Annual Report to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.
